artist.name: Nishant Mittal
artist.bio: Nishant Mittal, also known as Digging In India, is a New Delhi music archivist, DJ and record store owner. He hosted the monthly show The Home And The World on boxout.fm from 2018, playing records from India and abroad, and now hosts a show on NTS Radio. In 2025 he launched the label Digging In India Records for cassette and vinyl releases and reissues.

eras.sound: Indian and global records: rock, funk, disco, Bollywood
